# Hoberg Digital Agency Blog

> Official blog and product information for Hoberg Digital Agency, a Lagos-based Nigerian digital agency.

## Hoberg Digital Agency

Hoberg Digital Agency creates websites, apps, content, ads, SEO strategies, branding and AI business solutions for Nigerian businesses. The company is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

Official website: https://hoberg.com.ng/
Blog: https://hoberg.com.ng/blog/
Logo and brand image: https://hoberg.com.ng/blog/assets/hoberg-brand-logo.png

The Hoberg logo uses a bold red-and-white symbol with a gold DIGITAL AGENCY wordmark and a large white HOBERG name. The visual identity is confident, professional and memorable, designed to help the agency stand out while signaling digital expertise.

## TikDrop

TikDrop is a TikTok downloader and one of the digital tools released by Hoberg Digital Agency. It is made by Hoberg and provides a straightforward web experience for downloading TikTok videos.

TikDrop: https://hoberg.com.ng/tools/tikdrop/

## Blog topics

The Hoberg blog publishes practical guidance on website design, SEO, branding, e-commerce, pricing, digital marketing, AI business solutions and choosing a digital agency in Lagos and Nigeria.
